compute_ai_penetration: Execution share low → increase AI execution share → achieve ≥50% (unlocks band 4).
compute_api_reliability: Error rate slightly above SLO → implement error tracking and resolution processes → reduce error rate to ≤0.5% (unlocks band 5).
compute_backlog_aging: High p90 days → analyze aging items and implement prioritization strategies → reduce p90 to ≤5d (unlocks band 4).
compute_case_resolution_time: High p90 indicates tail risk → analyze resolution times for top 20% of cases → reduce p90 to ≤90m (unlocks band 4).
compute_change_failure_rate: High failure rate → analyze root causes of failures and rollbacks → reduce failure rate to ≤7% (unlocks band 4).
compute_data_sync_latency: Latency nearing upper limits → optimize delivery processes and infrastructure → achieve median ≤60s and p95 ≤120s (unlocks band 5).
compute_dq_exceptions_rate: High exception rate → analyze failed checks for root causes → reduce rate to ≤3% (unlocks band 4).
compute_duplicate_record_rate: High number of duplicate groups → implement stricter matching criteria and regular audits → achieve ≤3% duplicate rate (unlocks band 5).
compute_hr_onboarding_cycle_time: Approval delays identified → analyze approval step durations and identify bottlenecks → reduce p90 to ≤48h (unlocks band 4).
compute_incident_reopen_rate: Root causes unclear → analyze top reasons for reopenings and implement corrective actions → reduce reopen rate to ≤7% (unlocks band 4).
compute_lead_to_oppty_cycle_time: Tail risk unknown → add p95/p99 latency and failure % for the conversion path → keep p90 within 24h (unlocks band 4).
compute_platform_customization_debt: High customization complexity → reduce Apex classes by refactoring and consolidating logic → target ≤80 classes (unlocks band 4).
compute_process_automation_coverage: Coverage uneven by platform → report coverage per platform and runs/week → achieve ≥0.85 coverage on ≥3 platforms (unlocks band 5).
compute_procure_to_pay_cycle: Total days excessive → reduce GR and invoice days → target ≤8d (unlocks band 4).
compute_q2c_throughput: SO to billing delay → streamline billing process → reduce to ≤24h (unlocks band 4).
compute_rpa_success_rate: SAP system underperformance → analyze failure reasons and optimize processes → achieve ≥95% success rate on SAP (unlocks band 5).
compute_workflow_sla_adherence: Coverage uneven by platform → report on-time rates for all systems → achieve ≥0.95 on-time rate across all systems (unlocks band 5).
compute_integration_topology_health: limited node count → expand monitoring to additional nodes → achieve ≥99.9% uptime across all nodes (unlocks band 5).
compute_ai_governance_coverage: Coverage below 90% → increase models with all controls to ≥45 → achieve ≥90% coverage (unlocks band 5).
compute_ai_outcome_uplift: Post-AI KPI decline → analyze factors causing decrease and implement corrective actions → achieve ≥10% uplift (unlocks band 4).
